turns.text: If I get married to an American, I wouldn't have to go back to Russia.
turns.zh: 我要是嫁给一个美国人，就不用回俄罗斯了。

turns.text: And do you know where I can take this handsome gentleman to dinner?
turns.zh: 还有，你知道我可以带这位帅哥去哪儿吃晚饭吗？

turns.text: Well, you did tell them, right?
